# Mod's Engineering Mathematics

Mod's Engineering Mathematics is a Thai-language educational website and YouTube channel by Teerawut Savangboon (อาจารย์มด), lecturer in Electrical Engineering, Faculty of Science and Technology, Dhonburi Rajabhat University, Samut Prakan campus.

The site is a single page: https://modsengineeringmath.com/

Learning path (YouTube playlists, in order):
1. Matrix and Determinant — solving systems of linear equations: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLAJhR5azwWpJkUHNvACZSpBG2C7l7VJTO
2. Laplace Transforms — Laplace and inverse Laplace for differential equations: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLAJhR5azwWpLgWalcHsCEE8q_bPJv0Eaa
3. Feedback Control — feedback control systems: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLAJhR5azwWpK04F2C2Vp6h3v82Wvqn9ka
4. Power Electronics: Buck Converter — DC-DC buck converter: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLAJhR5azwWpJEprWclikULegqCgddv0PF

Main audience:
- Electrical engineering students
- First-year engineering students
- Thai learners who want to connect mathematics with real circuits

Language: Thai

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@modsengineeringmath
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/modsengineeringmath
University profile: https://sci.dru.ac.th/electrical-engineering/teerawutsavangboon.html
